baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three passive clauses join recitation to mountains, earth, and the dead before the pivot to God's command.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sequence tests one recited discourse across three resistant registers: consolidated height is put in motion, continuous ground is separated, and extinguished life is reconnected by intelligible address. The passives withhold agency until the command-pivot gathers it under God.

activation_trace.role: Reading and recitation supply the common operative medium across all three transformations.
Going and flowing give the first transformation its vector of released motion.
A raised solid aggregation supplies the resistant mass that motion overcomes.
Severance and separation turn the second transformation into loss of terrestrial continuity.
The lower expanse opposite heaven supplies the continuous plane being divided.
Intelligible speech connecting speakers makes restored relation, not bare animation, the third test.
Loss of force and life names the maximal resistance to communicative reconnection.
Authority and sovereignty receive the agency withheld by the preceding passive constructions.

changed_reading.before: Three unrelated impossible miracles illustrate maximal scriptural power.
changed_reading.after: One recited medium is imagined reconfiguring material fixity, spatial continuity, and communicative death, while its realization remains under sovereign command.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The command-pivot is followed by believers, severed hope, divine willing, gentle guidance, and all people.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus moves from total physical compulsion to a question about cutting off expectation. Because God could guide everyone, believers are pressed to release the hope that spectacular textual force must compel a uniform human response; guidance remains a directed relation under will.

activation_trace.role: The whole affair or state relocates efficacy from the imagined instrument to God's disposal.
Completion without remainder sharpens both total command and the counterfactual of all people.
The cutting off of hope supplies the demanded change in believer expectation.
Secure trust makes the addressees' release of coercive expectation a posture of confidence rather than defeat.
Will attached to an object makes universal guidance possible but explicitly counterfactual.
Gentle indication toward a path contrasts guidance with forced material displacement.
Human appearance over against wildness keeps the counterfactual concerned with responsive persons, not inert objects.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks why believers have not despaired in general.
changed_reading.after: It may ask them specifically to relinquish the expectation that even maximal signs should mechanically produce universal guidance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Speech to the dead is followed by a recurring striking event caused by what deniers make, either hitting them or settling near their abode.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus inventories place intelligible utterance and a bodily wound under the speech root, while the striking event can be both collision and a rebuke that hits a hearer. This permits a consequence to function as material address: authored conduct returns as a knock at or near the household.

activation_trace.role: Intelligible utterance supplies the communicative pole of the mechanism.
A wounding mark joins speech to bodily impact without making the two identical.
One thing striking another gives the event its literal percussion.
A rebuke that strikes the listener supplies the event's possible admonitory function.
A calamity reaching a person links the percussion to an experienced consequence.
Making or doing supplies the conduct to which the material address responds.
Circular enclosure makes the abode a bounded field around which the warning can settle.

changed_reading.before: The striking event is a separate punitive appendix after the failed miracle hypothetical.
changed_reading.after: It can continue the communication motif as a material knock generated by conduct and delivered at the boundary of lived space.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The deniers remain under an alternation of direct impact and nearby settlement until God's promise comes, followed by denial of missed appointment.
baseline_models.mechanism: Persistence, direct hit or nearby arrival, and an appointed promise form a distributed temporal process. Repeated local events are provisional installments rather than the terminal fulfillment, and the closing non-failure clause secures the endpoint rather than promising immediacy.

activation_trace.role: Persistence of state in the continuative construction stretches the warning across time.
Reaching and hitting a target supplies the direct branch of the alternation.
Settling in a place supplies the indirect nearby branch of the alternation.
Temporal nearness as something approaches completion lets spatial proximity also foreshadow an endpoint.
Coming marks the terminal promise as an arrival, not merely a statement.
An appointment bounded by time or place organizes the preceding events toward a fixed horizon.
A promise failing at its appointment names exactly what the closing negation excludes.

changed_reading.before: One final calamity is simply delayed.
changed_reading.after: Direct and adjacent events recur as distributed preliminaries until a distinct appointed fulfillment whose delay is not failure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier earth sequence first supplies fixed anchors, then adjacent parcels receiving one watering but yielding differentiated produce. This changes cut earth from only catastrophic rupture into bounded differentiation: a common input discloses distinct capacities without destroying adjacency.

activation_trace.role: Division into portions supplies the focus image that the context can recast as differentiation.
Firm anchoring establishes the stable terrestrial baseline against which movement is surprising.
A separated piece or tract makes cutting productive parceling rather than necessarily annihilation.
Neighbouring proximity preserves relation between the divided parcels.
Shared watering supplies the common input against which different reception becomes visible.
Increase and remainder mark unequal outputs from adjacent, commonly watered ground.

structural_cues: 13:3-4 moves from extended earth and fixed anchors to adjacent parcels, one watering, and differentiated yield.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stable ground, adjacent pieces, common watering, and unequal yield; I infer that the focus cutting can expose receptive differences. The live alternative is literal catastrophic fissuring.

changed_reading.before: Cutting the earth means only spectacular destruction of the ground.
changed_reading.after: It can also mean articulation into neighbouring receptive zones through which one recitation yields non-uniform effects.

context_deltas.mechanism: Descending water runs through valleys according to their measure, carries raised foam away, and leaves benefit in the earth. The focus transformations can therefore be read as channel formation and sorting: recitation does not flatten terrain but moves through capacities, separating transient surface reaction from what remains.

activation_trace.role: Gathering and joining let recitation function as a common inflow that encounters diverse channels.
Crossing distance or water lets terrestrial cutting become passage-making rather than only rupture.
Delivery by descent supplies the vertical arrival of the common medium.
Water supplies the material carrier for the context's routing analogy.
Flood-flow supplies movement through terrain and the force that bears material onward.
A valley as the flood's course makes capacity spatial and channel-specific.
A measure reaching its limit constrains how much each channel carries.
Floating foam supplies the conspicuous but transient response sorted from enduring benefit.
Remaining with patient stability marks the beneficial residue of the process.
Soft productive earth supplies the receiving substrate in which benefit remains.

structural_cues: 13:17 repeats descent, flow, measured valleys, foam removal, and terrestrial remainder in one causal sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a capacity-routed flow that sorts foam from benefit; I map recitation onto the common inflow and the focus terrain changes onto channel formation. The alternative is that the water parable concerns truth and falsehood without directly revising 13:31.

changed_reading.before: Qur'anic efficacy would be proved by uniformly overpowering resistant matter.
changed_reading.after: Its efficacy can be capacity-sensitive routing and sorting, with terrain reconfigured into channels and durable benefit distinguished from dramatic foam.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated demands for a visible sign are answered by warning and guidance, then by return, remembrance, heart-settling, and recitation of what was communicated. These steps strengthen the focus contrast between spectacular compulsion and a discourse whose positive effect appears as responsive reorientation.

activation_trace.role: Cutting off hope marks the release of sign-based expectations of compulsory response.
A manifest marker supplies the demanded evidentiary mode that the focus intensifies counterfactually.
Warning that awakens caution supplies a non-compulsive communicative function.
Gentle direction to a path pairs warning with locally mediated guidance.
The repeated visible-sign demand frames the immediate lead-in to the focus.
Habitual return supplies the recipient-side motion that guidance does not force.
Settled calm supplies the inward effect contrasted with displaced mountains.
The heart identifies the living receptive site of the discourse's movement.
Bringing something present after forgetfulness supplies the repeated practice that settles the heart.
Following in sequence makes recitation an enacted continuity rather than an isolated spectacle.
Knowledge conveyed in hidden fashion contrasts the discourse's quiet delivery with demanded spectacle.

structural_cues: 13:27-30 runs directly from repeated sign demand to return, heart-settling remembrance, and recitation among deniers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sign-demand, warning, return, remembrance, settled hearts, and recitation; I infer that this sequence names the noncoercive efficacy contrasted in 13:31. Alternatively, the sequence may only juxtapose separate pastoral themes.

changed_reading.before: Only a discourse producing public physical marvels would count as effective.
changed_reading.after: The focus rejects coercion as the measure of efficacy and points toward warning, voluntary return, remembered presence, and settled hearts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The storm sequence joins flash, fear and hope, thunder, severe overhead sound, and a targeted strike amid dispute. It gives the focus striking event an audible and admonitory register, strengthening the reading of a calamity as percussion that addresses without becoming ordinary verbal speech.

activation_trace.role: A bodily mark keeps communication open to an impact register.
A rebuke striking a hearer supplies the interpretive bridge from percussion to warning.
Flashing and thundering as threat supplies the anticipatory visual signal.
Heavenly thunder supplies the audible field in which the strike is heard.
A severe explosive sound binds the overhead event to acoustic impact.
Targeted arrival makes the storm's sound culminate in a directed hit.

structural_cues: 13:12-13 moves from fear-and-hope flash to praising thunder and a strike during active disputation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sound-to-strike sequence amid dispute; I infer that it can model the focus event as admonitory percussion. The alternative is a narrower weather-and-punishment scene with no communicative extension.

changed_reading.before: The recurring calamity merely injures or destroys.
changed_reading.after: It may also operate as a nonverbal warning that hits the hearer materially, though not every disaster should be decoded as a sentence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The true call is present, yet nonresponse is pictured as extended hands unable to make water reach the mouth. Physical presence, desire, and proximity do not complete reception. The focus speech-to-the-dead image therefore tests relation and response, not an automatic conversion produced by sheer delivery.

activation_trace.role: Intelligible speech supplies an offered connection whose completion remains in question.
Calling by speech supplies the address that can remain unanswered.
Truth stably matching reality prevents nonresponse from being blamed on an unreal call.
Returning speech and answering name the missing reciprocal act.
Extending the hand supplies effort and desire that still do not secure reception.
An outstretched palm in request embodies dependence without effective grasp.
Available water supplies the near but unreceived good.
Reaching the endpoint names the failed completion between offered good and recipient.
The open mouth supplies the bodily endpoint that proximity alone cannot reach.

structural_cues: 13:14 distinguishes a true call from response and stages failed transfer from water, through hand, to mouth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a valid call and a failed reception chain; I infer that it qualifies the focus fantasy of speech producing universal response. The alternative is that the analogy applies only to invocation of other powers.

changed_reading.before: If the discourse could address the dead, hearing or belief would necessarily follow.
changed_reading.after: Even maximal address does not erase the recipient-side act of response; delivery, nearness, and desire can coexist with failed reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The covenant sequence contrasts preserving and connecting with unbinding, cutting what was commanded to be joined, and corrupting the earth, ending in a bad abode. Earth-cutting thus acquires a social and legal topology: severed obligations partition a shared world and deform the household outcome.

activation_trace.role: Estrangement and severing connection open a relational sense inside the focus's terrestrial cutting.
Unbinding a firmly made structure supplies the destructive inverse of covenant continuity.
A confirmed covenant supplies the binding structure that cutting damages.
Uninterrupted succession without cutting defines the positive social continuity.
Contextual severance makes the focus cutting visibly available as broken relation.
Joining one thing to another identifies what the contextual cutting interrupts.
Departure from sound proportion names the resulting deformation of the shared order.
The terrestrial expanse becomes the field in which relational rupture takes public form.
Residence and belonging localize the social consequences in the abode echoed by the focus.

structural_cues: 13:20-25 forms a connect-versus-cut sequence and explicitly links severance to corruption in the earth and the outcome of the abode.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies commanded connection, covenant unbinding, cutting, earth-corruption, and abode; I infer a social topography within the focus earth image. The alternative remains a wholly geophysical miracle image.

changed_reading.before: The earth is cut only as inert matter in an impossible sign.
changed_reading.after: Earth can also be cut through severed obligations that partition common life, making the later nearness to the abode socially consequential.

context_deltas.mechanism: Change in a people is paired with change in themselves, while later scenes place every self under what it earns. These cues tighten the focus link between what deniers make and what reaches them: the recurring event reads as accountable feedback on authored patterns, without removing divine agency.

activation_trace.role: Making a thing supplies the authored conduct explicitly tied to the strike.
A calamity reaching a person supplies the returning consequence.
Changing a form or replacing a state supplies the two-sided transformation sequence.
The very self locates one side of change within the acting subjects.
Each self as the thing itself individualizes the field of oversight.
Acquiring through effort supplies the accountable output attached to each self.
Repeated earned acquisition confirms the conduct-to-account pattern near the surah's close.
The repeated individual self keeps the feedback accountable rather than merely collective weather.

structural_cues: 13:11 pairs outer and inner change; 13:33 and 13:42 repeat each self together with what it earns.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies internal change, earned action, oversight, and the focus's because-of-what-they-made relation; I infer a feedback arrow from patterned action to experienced event. A live alternative is juridical accounting without worldly causal feedback.

changed_reading.before: The strike is an externally imposed event only loosely associated with prior conduct.
changed_reading.after: It can be read as divinely governed feedback in which manufactured patterns return to accountable selves and communities.

context_deltas.mechanism: A sign can arrive only by permission; every term has an established record; erasure and stabilization remain under God; the messenger may witness only part of what is promised, while delivery and account are divided; then earth is diminished from its edges. The focus promise becomes an authorized schedule that may unfold partially and edgewise before its terminal appointment.

activation_trace.role: A time becoming due or delayed gives the imagined recitation a latent temporal register.
A promise bounded by an appointed time or place supplies the controlling horizon.
Coming marks the sign as an event whose arrival is governed.
A visible marker identifies the class of event whose timing is restricted.
Permission licenses the event and blocks autonomous sign production.
A fixed temporal limit supplies the schedule's bounded duration.
A recorded determination that entails judgment makes each term authoritative rather than accidental.
Removal of an effect supplies one pole of schedule revision.
Enduring fixation supplies the other pole of what remains established.
A spoken promise opening expectation permits partial witness without exhausting the promised whole.
Delivering the message delimits the messenger's task from event realization.
Counting and account reserve the terminal reckoning beyond delivery.
Coming to the earth turns fulfillment into an advancing process.
The terrestrial expanse supplies the same material field as the focus cutting.
Loss of part supplies incremental rather than all-at-once transformation.
The limit or edge localizes where the gradual terrestrial change appears.
Restraining and returning for correction makes the edgewise process subject to decisive governance.

structural_cues: 13:38-41 orders permission, fixed term, erasure or stabilization, partial witness, delivery versus account, and earth diminished at its edges.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies authorization, term, record, revision, partial witness, and edge-loss; I infer that the focus's recurring events are staged advances toward the appointment. Alternatives include separate prophetic-history and territorial referents with no single process model.

changed_reading.before: The promised transformation is an all-at-once marvel whose delay risks looking like failure.
changed_reading.after: It can unfold by authorized installments, partial witness, and edgewise terrestrial change while remaining ordered to a non-failed appointment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the packet's non-dominant mapping for the guidance root carries demolition and loud sound, not the ordinary form's direct sense. It remains anchored by the exact focus root and by the preceding mountain, earth, speech, and striking images; downstream prose should present it only as a contrastive acoustic-force shadow, never as a replacement translation of guidance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The universal-guidance counterfactual follows imagined demolition-scale signs and precedes repeated striking events.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction supplies the ordinary guidance pole that the outlier must not displace.
Severe breaking and demolition echo the focus's imagined movement and cutting as a coercive shadow.
A loud reverberating sound echoes speech and the later knock, sharpening the force-versus-guidance contrast.

changed_reading.before: Universal guidance is simply a larger quantity of the same gentle direction.
changed_reading.after: The split inventory lets the counterfactual carry a contained shadow of demolition and overwhelming sound, clarifying what coerced guidance would resemble and why the verse refuses to equate it with recitation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because womb-carriage and a due or delayed time are peripheral images of the recitation root. It remains anchored in the focus noun, the gathered totality, and the closing appointed promise; downstream prose should call it a temporal-gestational activation rather than lexical definition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening recitation hypothetical is held unresolved until the closing arrival of a promise that cannot miss its appointment.

activation_trace.role: A womb gathering and carrying a pregnancy supplies latent transformation held before emergence.
A time becoming due or delayed supplies maturation toward an appointed disclosure.
Joining dispersed parts into a collected whole supports the image of carried potential.
The bounded appointment supplies the eventual emergence point of the carried process.

changed_reading.before: The hypothetical asks only whether recitation could trigger an immediate spectacle.
changed_reading.after: It can also activate an image of discourse carrying gathered transformations toward a due time, so non-immediacy becomes maturation rather than impotence.

strongest_changes: Earth-cutting changed from pure catastrophe into both adjacent differentiation and capacity-forming channels.
The sign demand changed into a contrast between coercive spectacle and responsive return, remembrance, and settled hearts.
The recurring strike changed from an isolated punishment into material warning and accountable feedback.
The unfailing promise changed from delayed single impact into an authorized, partial, edgewise schedule.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's impossible triad did not settle into one miracle claim: the packet activated material, hydrological, auditory, social, inward, and temporal mechanisms that remain anchored to the same focus constructions and can coexist without harmonization.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntax and pragmatic force of the believers' severed hope remain open, so the anti-coercion reading is medium rather than decisive.
The terrain, water, storm, covenant, and edge sequences may be analogical activators rather than intended direct glosses of the focus.
The non-dominant guidance mapping and temporal-gestational recitation branches are deliberately retained as contained form-distant outliers.
